units.source_text: 这次告别赛规定四十个小时，同名人破格的时限相比，大约是其两倍。

en.t: This farewell match was set at forty hours, about twice as long as the exceptional time limit given to the Master.

units.source_text: 比一般棋手的时限延长了四倍。

en.t: It was four times longer than the time limit for ordinary players.

units.source_text: 简直像是没有时间限制了。

en.t: It was almost as if there were no time limit at all.
